answer: Picture a meadow of agents grazing on shared compute: a thousand fake identities would crowd out real ones. So every newcomer must carry a signed cargo manifest to the wharf, where three established agents inspect one sampled task result and co-sign it. Each co-signer risks its own score if the cargo proves fabricated, and the forge of reputation only accepts co-signed work. Faking an identity therefore means bribing or deceiving three vouchers per fake.
